subject: Streaming chat stalls during high concurrency window - customer escalation
messages:
From: Tina Alvarez <tina@fastretail.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2029 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: odd delays in streaming chat during 5-6pm PST

Hi team,

We experienced multiple customer complaints between ~17:45-18:10 PST today where streaming chat responses stalled for 6-18s mid-response. This is affecting checkout-support flows for priority merchants.

What we observed:
- p95 up to ~2.1s but p99 spiking to 8-18s during the window
- multiple clients report partial response followed by long pause, then final token(s) arrive
- some WebSocket connections reset after ~30s

We attached a short trace and a screenshot of the client console. Can you confirm if this is on your side or ours? We have a Black Friday test coming up and this is concerning.

Thanks,
Tina
Tina Alvarez
Head of Platform, FastRetail
Attachments: fastretail_20291115_stream_trace.log (40KB), console_pause.png
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Tina Alvarez <tina@fastretail.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Hi Tina — thanks for the quick signal and the trace. We're investigating now and I’ve looped in SRE and engineering.

Immediate plan:
- Dev will pull the traces and correlate with our ingress logs.
- Rishi will check capacity/routing and any autoscaler activity during the window.
- I’ll coordinate customer comms and schedule a follow-up in 60 minutes.

We take this seriously — I’ll update you with findings and a mitigation plan shortly.

— Priyom
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2029 18:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: odd delays in streaming chat during 5-6pm PST

Quick technical summary from initial triage:
- Correlated FastRetail trace with our ingress: around 17:42-17:58 PST there were sharp increases in concurrent streaming sessions for the FastRetail tenant (~3.5x baseline).
- We observed a rising queue length on the SSE/WebSocket write buffers on a subset of serving nodes. The runtime’s continuous batching window combined with the large number of near-simultaneous small requests led to increased per-request latency for tail tokens.
- There are intermittent connection resets from the LB to some worker pods when client retransmit/backpressure occurs; those correlate with the 30s reset reports.
- No model-side CPU/GPU saturation was observed; GPU utilization remained in normal ranges. Memory/kv-cache metrics show small growth but not OOM.

Attachments: conn-queue-lengths.csv, flame_kvcache.png (heatmap of kv cache lookups).

Immediate mitigations I recommend:
1) Increase concurrency headroom: temporarily route FastRetail to dedicated pool with larger max-inflight (short-term).
2) Reduce continuous batching window for streaming to favor lower tail latency for this tenant.
3) Enable fallback to non-streaming generation for sessions with >200 concurrent streams for 10 minutes while we stabilize.

I can push 1 and 2 within 25 minutes if we approve.

- Dev
Lead Engineer, Runtime
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2029 18:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: odd delays in streaming chat during 5-6pm PST

Adding operational context:
- Autoscaler logs show a short lag in scale-up for the affected node pool between 17:40-17:46 — scaling initiated but provisioning and pod readiness trailed request spike by ~120s.
- LB health checks showed transient 502/504s from three workers before they recovered.
- We did not hit global quota limits but a placement imbalance concentrated load on a smaller subset of nodes.

My actions:
- I’m moving FastRetail traffic to the next-available pool and will trigger a manual scale to add headroom.
- I recommend temporary rate-limit protections and the fallback suggested by Dev to cut the tail risk quickly.

I’ll post a follow-up when the route is moved.

— Rishi
SRE Manager
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Tina Alvarez <tina@fastretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Nov 2029 18:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: odd delays in streaming chat during 5-6pm PST

Tina — update: we’ve moved FastRetail traffic to a higher-headroom pool and reduced the streaming batch window for the tenant. Rishi also enabled conservative throttles for extremely high concurrency sessions.

Preliminary results: p99 for streaming responses in the tenant dropped from ~12s to ~1.8s in the 10 minutes after the change. We continued to monitor for 30 minutes — no further mass stalls observed.

We’d like to propose three next steps:
- a) Temporary credit for the outage window (we can propose 10% for the affected hour)
- b) A runbook change to proactively move large tenants to dedicated pools during known promotional spikes
- c) A short postmortem and follow-up fix to improve autoscaler responsiveness and placement balance.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll escalate to Sales leadership and Ops for a formal credit and PM for the postmortem.

Thanks for the quick heads-up — sorry for the disruption, we’ll own the remediation.

— Priyom
